Here’s a high-level advanced Keras project focused on hyperparameter optimization using Keras Tuner with a modern dataset and state-of-the-art techniques.

Project Title

ai-ml-ds-KerasTunerCIFAR100
File name: auto_hyperparam_cifar100_tuner.py

📄 Short Description

Build a convolutional neural network (CNN) for CIFAR‑100 image classification, using Keras Tuner (Hyperband + Bayesian) to automatically optimize architecture (depth, width, dropout, data‑aug) and training hyperparameters. Advanced components: preprocessing layers, transfer learning trunk, tuner subclass for custom trial logic.

⏱️ Timestamp

2025‑07‑15T00:00:00Z

🧠 Problem Domain

Computer Vision — multiclass image classification (100 classes).

🔧 Frameworks

  • TensorFlow 2.x + Keras
  • Keras Tuner (Hyperband & Bayesian)
  • TensorFlow Datasets (CIFAR‑100)
# auto_hyperparam_cifar100_tuner.py

import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model
import keras_tuner as kt
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds

# === Data Load & Preprocessing ===
(ds_train, ds_val, ds_test), ds_info = tfds.load(
    "cifar100",
    split=["train[:80%]", "train[80%:]", "test"],
    with_info=True,
    as_supervised=True,
)

IMG_SHAPE: tuple = (32,32,3)
NUM_CLASSES: int = ds_info.features["label"].num_classes

def preprocess(ds, batch_size: int=64):
    def _prep(image, label):
        img: tf.Tensor = tf.cast(image, tf.float32) / 255.0
        return img, label
    return ds.map(_prep).shuffle(1000).batch(batch_size).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

train_ds = preprocess(ds_train)
val_ds   = preprocess(ds_val)
test_ds  = preprocess(ds_test)

# === HyperModel Definition ===
def build_model(hp: kt.HyperParameters) -> Model:
    inputs = layers.Input(shape=IMG_SHAPE)
    x = inputs

    # Tunable Data Augmentation
    if hp.Boolean("aug_flip"):
        x = layers.RandomFlip()(x)
    if hp.Boolean("aug_rot"):
        x = layers.RandomRotation(hp.Float("rot_rate", 0.0, 0.3, step=0.05))(x)
    if hp.Boolean("aug_zoom"):
        x = layers.RandomZoom(hp.Float("zoom_rate",0.0,0.2,step=0.05))(x)

    # Transfer trunk depth + trainability
    base_model = tf.keras.applications.ResNet50(
        include_top=False, input_shape=IMG_SHAPE, weights="imagenet"
    )
    if hp.Boolean("trunk_freeze"):
        base_model.trainable = False
    else:
        base_model.trainable = True

    x = base_model(x, training=False)
    x = layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D()(x)

    # Dense head
    for i in range(hp.Int("dense_layers", 1, 3)):
        units = hp.Int(f"units_{i}", 128, 512, step=128)
        x = layers.Dense(units, activation=hp.Choice("act", ["relu", "selu"]))(x)
        if hp.Boolean(f"dropout_{i}"):
            x = layers.Dropout(hp.Float(f"drop_rate_{i}", 0.1, 0.5, step=0.1))(x)

    outputs = layers.Dense(NUM_CLASSES, activation="softmax")(x)

    model = Model(inputs, outputs)
    lr = hp.Float("lr", 1e-5, 1e-3, sampling="log")
    model.compile(
        optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(lr),
        loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"],
    )
    return model

# === Custom Tuner Subclass (Bonus) ===
class MyTuner(kt.BayesianOptimization):
    def on_epoch_end(self, trial, model, epoch, logs=None, **kwargs):
        super().on_epoch_end(trial, model, epoch, logs, **kwargs)
        # Example advanced callback: conditional early pruning
        if logs.get("val_accuracy",0) < 0.2 and epoch > 3:
            self.oracle.update_trial(trial.trial_id, {"val_accuracy": -1})
            self.stop_training = True

# === Tuner Initialization & Search ===
tuner = MyTuner(
    hypermodel=build_model,
    objective="val_accuracy",
    max_trials=20,
    directory="keras_tuner_logs",
    project_name="cifar100_advanced",
)

tuner.search(
    train_ds,
    validation_data=val_ds,
    epochs=15,
    callbacks=[tf.keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(patience=3)],
)

# === Train Best Model ===
best_hp = tuner.get_best_hyperparameters(1)[0]
model = tuner.hypermodel.build(best_hp)
model.fit(train_ds, validation_data=val_ds, epochs=30, callbacks=[tf.keras.callbacks.ReduceLROnPlateau()])

# === Evaluate ===
loss, acc = model.evaluate(test_ds)
print(f"Test Loss={loss:.4f}, Test Acc={acc:.4f}")

# === Save ===
model.save("best_cifar100_model.h5")

🧪 Example Inputs & Expected Outputs

  • Case 1:
    No input from user. Program auto hues hyperparams, prints: Best hyperparameters found: dense_layers=2, units_0=256, ... Outputs final test accuracy: Test Loss=1.1234, Test Acc=0.65

🚀 Key Learnings & Research Areas

✅ Use Cases

  • Fast prototyping of image classifiers with automatic tuning
  • Benchmarking auto search vs hand-designed models
  • Transfer learning on different image datasets

🧩 Sister Projects

  • Auto NLP classification (IMDB, SST-2)
  • Hyperparameter tuning for segmentation (COCO)
  • NAS with HyperResNet/Xception tuners

🔗 Integration Opportunities

  • Deploy model via TensorFlow Serving / TFX
  • Combine with AutoML pipelines
  • Integrate with Ray Tune or Optuna backends

🗂️ Full Development Lifecycle

  1. Data ingestion (TFDS), augmentation baseline
  2. Dev: define HP search space + HyperModel
  3. Auto-tuning & evaluation
  4. Model export, CI/CD, Dockerization
  5. Monitoring accuracy, drift, retraining

⏳ Timeframe

  • Data & model builder: 2 days
  • Tuner setup + passes: 3–5 days
  • Evaluation + refinement: 2 days
  • Total: ~1–2 weeks

🎯 Final Product

A fully trained, tuned image classifier packaged with best-hp summary, saved model, and reproducible hyperparameter logs; ready for production deployment.

💡 Bonus (Pro)

  • Custom MyTuner subclass halts low‑performing epochs, saving compute
  • Combines data‑aug, tuning, transfer learning in one pipeline

📈 Where to Go From Here

  • Extend to Neural Architecture Search (e.g. integrate KerasTuner’s HyperResNet)
  • Integrate with AutoAugment search
  • Deploy via TFX + continuous retraining pipelines
  • Scale tuning across GPUs or cloud (e.g. Google AI Platform)

This is a significantly more advanced, production-oriented, auto-tuned Keras project than typical tutorials. It combines modern tools, AutoML, transfer learning, and custom tuning logic.
